summary: Full end-to-end verification of Inventory extras iteration 12: Job Order/Produksi (BOM auto-decrement + margin calc + complete/cancel/delete with stock rollback), Stock Adjustment (Opname), monthly Waste Report (Excel + PDF downloads), and Dashboard Inventory Widget. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed. Frontend: full UI flow verified via Playwright (login → dashboard widget → 5 inventory tabs → create material → create order with BOM → stock deducted → complete order → opname adjust → waste XLSX/PDF downloads → cancel order rollback → dashboard widget refresh).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L3505 _next_order_no uses count_documents() to seed the sequential order number. This is NOT concurrency-safe under simultaneous POSTs (two callers could get the same order_no). Acceptable for single-admin usage but consider Mongo findAndModify on a counter doc for future multi-user scenarios.

server.py L3577..3587 creates the order doc BEFORE decrementing stock (two-phase, non-atomic). If the server crashes between insert_one and updates the stock decrement is lost, leaving the order 'aktif' with stock still full. Suggest wrapping in a mongo transaction (requires replica set) or at minimum, upsert-log the pending decrement.

server.py L3611 (cancel endpoint) returns 200 with {status:'batal'} both when already batal and when transitioning; that is idempotent (good). Note: same endpoint does NOT reject cancelling a 'selesai' order — it will still refund stock. Confirmed acceptable per problem statement (cancel + rollback allowed on 'aktif' or 'selesai').

server.py L3673 waste report unit_price_snapshot column: waste docs use 'unit_price_snapshot'? — actually the waste POST in inventory storage stores 'unit_price_snapshot' (verified by code path around L3400s). If waste docs lack this field, Excel prints 0. Not a bug, but worth documenting; PDF report correctly formats 'Rp -' via estimated_loss.

Frontend Inventory.jsx L735/739 opens the order modal with items pre-populated with the first activeMaterials[0] (`quantity:0`). If admin forgets to change qty, the modal still lets them add empty rows or set item#0 qty=0. Backend now correctly rejects zero-quantity items (400) — verified in tests — so UX would show error toast rather than silently create bad orders.

Non-blocking: option-inside-span hydration warning from Emergent dev overlay on <select> inside modals (order-item-mat-*, adj-material). This is dev-only instrumentation and does not affect functionality (verified all POSTs succeed with correct material_id values). Same finding as iteration_11.

Dashboard widget InventoryWidget uses inv_summary from /api/dashboard/stats. If inventory collection is empty, `inv_summary` becomes None due to exception, and UI will render null. Consider defaulting to empty {} in the backend so the frontend always renders zeroes rather than hiding the widget.
